It does not say that legacy `num_shards` grouping stays cluster-wide. It also does not mention a provider change comparing `autoScalingMode: CLUSTER` with `SHARD`. The Atlas API values are INDEPENDENT_SHARD_SCALING and CLUSTER_WIDE_SCALING, and the provider CHANGELOG has no `autoScalingMode` entry. Those two statements are therefore left out.
